entities.summary: The Tang campaigns against the Western Turks, were a series of military campaigns conducted by the Tang dynasty against the Western Turkic Khaganate in the 7th century. Early military conflicts were a result of the Tang interventions in the rivalry between the Western and Eastern Turks to weaken both. Under Emperor Taizong, campaigns were dispatched in the Western Regions against Gaochang in 640, Karasahr in 644 and 648, and Kucha in 648.
